notes: Grey painted stucco two-storey; upper: long horizontal window band; ground: full-height steel bar gate on the left, a door, a gated window on the right. Steel grille on the right-hand door so the Folsom face reads gated. Mid grey-tan scanned plaster (not near-white ribbed stucco), reflective shop glazing instead of an opaque dark slab. Milky three-bay storefront over a concrete plinth, a tall steel bar gate on the right, a strip of small lights above the shop glass, a dark painted band under the top storey, tall steel-sash windows divided by slim pilasters, a flat parapet cap. Mid-grey smooth painted concrete (cast-stone-trim, neutral grey, no scanned plaster, no flutes), dark grey band, heavy steel grille gate moved to the NE end with a short pier after it; reflective dark shop glass (glassModel). Smooth painted stucco grey (no cast-stone grain), no streak weathering. Dark grey painted concrete (was mid grey that read tan in warm light), dark reflective steel-window band, frosted shop glass. Mid warm grey with the maroon-brown band under the steel-window band. Multi-pane shop window, opaque pale grey glass. Soot at the base, grime, faint wide streaks.
